source_caption:
Jake Gyllenhaal developed Detective Loki’s signature blinking and twitchy mannerisms in Prisoners as a way to show the character’s inner tension and obsessive focus without relying on dialogue. Director Denis Villeneuve encouraged these subtle choices, making the performance feel more unsettling and layered.

Prisoners (2013), directed by Denis Villeneuve, starring Hugh Jackman, Jake Gyllenhaal, Viola Davis. A dark and gripping thriller that explores desperation, morality, and the limits a parent will cross when their child goes missing.

source_details.synopsis: Prisoners is a 2013 American crime thriller film directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Aaron Guzikowski. The film has an ensemble cast including Hugh Jackman, Jake Gyllenhaal, Viola Davis, Maria Bello, Terrence Howard, Melissa Leo, and Paul Dano. The film follows the abduction of two young girls in Pennsylvania and the subsequent search for the perpetrator by the police. After police arrest a young suspect and release him, the father of one of the daughters takes matters into his own hands.
